source.description:
## PROBLEM

Default and optional **skill** payloads AND default **hook** payloads are currently copied per-repo into `<repo>/.xtrm/{skills/{default,optional},hooks}/` on every `xt init`/`xt update --apply`, and xtrm-owned hook entries are written into `<repo>/.claude/settings.json` on every reconcile. Users managing xtrm across 10+ repos hit N drift diffs, N update runs, N re-materialized symlink farms per skill release, AND N settings.json rewrites per hook release. Symlink management has broken twice already (PR #197 regression guard `check-skills-symlinks.mjs`). Hook wiring has its own outstanding safety concern (`xtrm-s5ih5`: `xt install --global must not overwrite project hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json`). Sibling project `@jaggerxtrm/specialists` cut over to a canonical-package model for specialists; we lag behind for skills and hooks.

## SUCCESS

- `~/.xtrm/skills/{default,optional,user,active}/` is the single source of truth for default + optional skills.
- `~/.xtrm/hooks/` is the single source of truth for canonical hook payloads.
- `~/.xtrm/config/hooks.json` holds canonical hook wiring globally.
- New xtrm-tools installs no longer materialize `<repo>/.xtrm/skills/{default,optional}/` or `<repo>/.xtrm/hooks/*` (only project-scoped overrides remain per-repo).
- `~/.claude/skills` and `~/.pi/agent/skills` are symlinks into `~/.xtrm/skills/active/`.
- `~/.claude/settings.json.hooks` and `~/.pi/settings.json.hooks` receive xtrm-owned entries via safe-merge with per-entry source tagging (`_source: "xtrm-global"`, `_xtrm: {version, installedAt, hash}`) — non-xtrm keys never touched (subsumes `xtrm-s5ih5`).
- Per-repo `<repo>/.xtrm/skills/user/`, `service-skills/`, and project-scoped hook payloads/entries continue to work unchanged.
- `xt migrate all` cleanly removes per-repo default skills, per-repo global-covered hook payloads, and xtrm-owned hook entries from `<repo>/.claude/settings.json` — with SHA-verified equality + tarball backup + `--all-repos` batch mode + `--restore <backup>` reversal.
- `xt update` in a fresh install pulls new defaults globally via `xt bootstrap` (or lazy self-heal) — no per-repo action required.
- Every hook payload survives being wired globally: fast-fail guard at entry (`existsSync(cwd/.xtrm)` check) prevents side effects in non-xtrm sessions.
- Zero regressions in current test suites.

## SCOPE

Bounded surfaces affected (full file map in `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-dawid-dev-core/07e1094c-64b5-4516-9179-c11a451cf97e/scratchpad/skills-global-migration-plan.md` §6):

**Skills**:
- `cli/src/core/`: `skills-layout.ts`, `skills-runtime-views.ts`, `skills-materializer.ts`, `skills-scaffold.ts`, `skills-state.ts`, `skill-discovery.ts`, `registry-scaffold.ts`, `service-skills-ensure.ts`, `pi-runtime.ts`, `drift.ts`, new `global-skills-bootstrap.ts`.
- `cli/src/commands/`: `install.ts`, `init.ts`, `update.ts`, `skills.ts`, `clean.ts`, `doctor.ts`, `worktree-*.ts`, new `bootstrap.ts`, new `migrate.ts`.
- `cli/src/adapters/claude.ts` (skills capability path).

**Hooks**:
- `cli/src/core/claude-runtime-sync.ts:198-260` — extend `reconcileProjectClaudeHooks` and `ensureGlobalStatusLine` into full global-hook reconciler with source tagging.
- New `cli/src/core/global-hooks-bootstrap.ts`.
- New `cli/src/core/pi-runtime-hooks.ts` (Pi analog of the reconciler).
- `.xtrm/hooks/`: audit every payload for fast-fail guard (`beads-*.mjs`, `quality-check.*`, `specialists-agent-guard.mjs`, `using-xtrm-reminder.mjs`, `worktree-boundary.mjs`, `xtrm-*-logger.mjs`, `gitnexus/`, `specialists/`).
- `.xtrm/config/hooks.json` — canonical wiring stays authored in-repo; ships to `~/.xtrm/config/hooks.json` at bootstrap.
- `policies/`: `service-skills.json`, `service-skills-claude.json` — hook commands resolve via the composed active view.

**Shared / cross-cutting**:
- `cli/src/utils/`: `worktree-session.ts`, `repo-root.ts`.
- `scripts/`: `gen-registry.mjs` (add `install_scope` field to `skills`, `skills_optional`, `hooks`, `config`), `check-registry-pack-parity.mjs`, `check-skills-symlinks.mjs`, `check-layout-guards.mjs`, `verify-asset-contract.mjs`, `vendor-specialists-skills.mjs`, `verify-specialists-vendor.mjs`, `check-skills-ownership.mjs`, new `check:global-skills-parity`.
- `packages/pi-extensions/`: `extensions/service-skills/index.ts`, `extensions/xtrm-loader/index.ts` + stale mirrors.
- `.xtrm/skills/default/migrating-to-global/` — new skill.
- `docs/`: `skills.md`, `skills-tier-architecture.md`, `skills-ownership.{json,md,release.json}`, `project-skills.md`, `service-skills-auto-reconcile.md`, `xtrm-directory.md`, `policies.md`, `cli-architecture.md`, `pi-extensions.md`, `hooks.md`, `plans/global-skills-hooks-migration.md` (new).
- Root docs: `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `XTRM-GUIDE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Tests: 28 skill test files + hook-reconciler and safe-merge tests (added in Batch J and Batch I).

## NON_GOALS

- Per-repo user packs (`.xtrm/skills/user/packs/`) migration — stays project-scoped.
- Per-repo project-scoped hook payloads and settings.json entries — stay project-scoped.
- Service-skills v2 machinery redesign — writes to per-repo `user/packs/<repo>-services/` unchanged.
- Global specialists — specialists already migrated; no further work here.
- Windows-specific dev-mode symlink workarounds.
- Replacing hook resolution with pure package resolution à la specialists' `import.meta.url` — runtime hooks reference absolute paths (`~/.xtrm/hooks/*.mjs`) in settings.json.
- Migrating settings.json fields other than `hooks` (permissions, model, statusLine handled by existing `ensureGlobalStatusLine`).
- Refactoring the hook implementations themselves — payloads move as-is; only fast-fail guards added.
- Migrating the ownership manifest to a runtime resolver — `docs/skills-ownership.json` stays authoring-time.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Sequencing: Batches A→B→{C, D, J}→E is hard-sequential (scaffold → bootstrap → per-repo retirement + hook wiring → migration cleanup). F can parallelize once A lands. G/H land after E. Rollout in three release phases: preview (feature-flagged `XTRM_GLOBAL_SKILLS=1` AND `XTRM_GLOBAL_HOOKS=1`) → default-on (opt-out `XTRM_LEGACY_SKILLS=1` / `XTRM_LEGACY_HOOKS=1`) → legacy code removal.
- Wire-format compatibility: registry.json v1 schema stays; `skills`/`skills_optional`/`hooks`/`config` assets gain `install_scope: "global"|"project"`.
- Migration destructive actions only when: global bootstrap done AND git-clean under `.xtrm/skills/default/` and `.xtrm/hooks/` AND (SHA-equality OR user-approved discard/relocate) AND for hook entries: `_source == "xtrm-global"` OR hash matches canonical AND global equivalent exists. Backup mandatory.
- Runtime pointer assertions (`assertRuntimeSkillsViews`) migrate atomically with pointer emission.
- **Safe-merge invariant for settings.json**: bytes outside the `hooks` field never change. `hooks` field changes only for entries owned by `xtrm-global` (source-tagged or hash-matched). This directly answers the `xtrm-s5ih5` concern.
- Every hook payload gets a fast-fail guard at entry to survive being wired globally into non-xtrm sessions.
- Logging: every install/update/bootstrap/migrate step logs to xtrm's structured format at `~/.xtrm/logs/skills-migration.jsonl` with `component: "skills-bootstrap"|"hooks-bootstrap"|"skills-migrate"|"hooks-migrate"|"hooks-reconcile"`. Never log absolute file contents or hook command strings that might carry sensitive paths; hash them.
- Public CLI surface: `xt bootstrap`, `xt migrate [skills|hooks|all]`, `xt skills --global` (default flip). Backwards-compat: existing `xt update --apply` in unmigrated repos still succeeds with a nudge.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Fresh install: `npm i -g @jaggerxtrm/xtrm-tools@<preview>` then `xt init` in a scratch repo → global `~/.xtrm/{skills/{default,optional,active},hooks,config/hooks.json}` populated, `~/.claude/skills` symlink created, `~/.claude/settings.json.hooks` receives xtrm-global entries, no per-repo copies.
- [ ] `xt update --apply` in an unmigrated repo → composes global active + repo user, prints migration nudge, no destructive action.
- [ ] `xt migrate all --dry-run` on 5 real repos (`vaultctl`, `transcriptoz`, `console`, `xtrm`, `specialists`) → clean verdict table for both skills and hooks, zero false-diverged.
- [ ] `xt migrate all --apply` on same 5 → tarballs at `~/.xtrm/migration-backups/`, per-repo `default/optional/` gone, global-covered hook payloads gone, xtrm-global hook entries removed from `<repo>/.claude/settings.json`, foreign + user-authored entries preserved, `user/`+`service-skills/`+project hooks preserved, runtime pointers valid.
- [ ] `xt migrate --restore <backup>` → repo returns to pre-migration state byte-identical.
- [ ] All 28 skill test files + new hook-reconciler tests pass green.
- [ ] `npm run check:registry-pack-parity`, `check:skills-symlinks`, `check:skills-ownership`, new `check:global-skills-parity`, new `check:hook-source-tagging` all green in `prepublishOnly`.
- [ ] `xt doctor` on migrated repo reports clean; on unmigrated repo surfaces both pending migrations.
- [ ] Smoke: `service-skills` cataloger + activator + drift-detector still fire in a repo with a live `service-registry.json`.
- [ ] Smoke: `beads-*.mjs` fast-fail guard verified — running `node ~/.xtrm/hooks/beads-claim-sync.mjs` in a non-xtrm dir exits 0 with no side effects.
- [ ] Safe-merge invariant: fixture `~/.claude/settings.json` with user-authored `permissions` block + user-authored `hooks` entry + orphaned xtrm-global entry → after `xt bootstrap`, permissions untouched, user-authored entry preserved, orphaned entry updated/removed.
- [ ] xtrm-s5ih5 explicitly closed as validated by this epic.
- [ ] Log evidence: `jq '.event' ~/.xtrm/logs/skills-migration.jsonl` returns `bootstrap.*`, `hook.reconcile.*`, `migrate.repo.*`, `migrate.skills.*`, `migrate.hooks.*` sequences.

## OUTPUT

At epic close: PR chain (one per batch), demo run of full migration across the 5 fixture repos with backups uploaded to a release artifact, upgrade notes in `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/plans/global-skills-hooks-migration.md` marked shipped, telemetry sample confirming migration audit log format matches contract, `xtrm-s5ih5` closed with pointer to Batch J's source-tagging design, residual-risk note enumerating repos on old xtrm-tools versions that haven't upgraded yet.

## REFERENCES

- Migration plan draft: `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-dawid-dev-core/07e1094c-64b5-4516-9179-c11a451cf97e/scratchpad/skills-global-migration-plan.md` (full architecture, batches, risks — updated to cover hooks).
- Sibling precedent: `/home/dawid/dev/specialists` — canonical-asset-resolver (`src/specialist/canonical-asset-resolver.ts`), loader precedence (`src/specialist/loader.ts:130-192`), drift-detector (`src/specialist/drift-detector.ts`), prune-stale-defaults CLI (`src/cli/prune-stale-defaults.ts`).
- Existing global-hook precedent in this repo: `cli/src/core/claude-runtime-sync.ts:245-260` (`ensureGlobalStatusLine`) — safe-merge pattern already used for statusline; Batch J generalizes it.
- Prior art in this repo: `xtrm-9xg2.2` (flat active layout guards), `xtrm-9xg2.3` (runtime checks) — subsumed by this epic. `xtrm-s5ih5` — directly addressed by Batch J's source-tagging design.
- Adjacent: `xtrm-n74m8` (stale pre-v2 service-skills trinity) — the migration skill can also nudge cleanup.

## APPROACH NOTES

Recon: three parallel Explore agents produced the impact map. Blast-radius summary: MEDIUM aggregate. Batch C (per-repo skills scaffold retirement) and Batch J (hook safe-merge into `~/.claude/settings.json`) are the two individually higher-risk tasks — both feature-flagged. Symbols with widest fan-out: `scaffoldSkillsDefaultFromPackage`, `installFromRegistry`, `ensureAgentsSkillsSymlink`, `reconcileProjectClaudeHooks`. None have HIGH/CRITICAL impact alone; aggregate risk comes from the coupled pointer + scaffold + registry + settings-merge retargeting.

source.description:
## PROBLEM
Consumer repos have <repo>/.xtrm/skills/{default,optional}/ + <repo>/.xtrm/hooks/ + xtrm-owned hook entries in <repo>/.claude/settings.json still materialized. Global paths (batches A-J) now serve them. Ship a safe migration.

## SUCCESS
- New xt migrate CLI: xt migrate [skills|hooks|all] [--dry-run|--apply] [--repo <path>] [--yes]
- For each per-repo asset: SHA-verify hash against corresponding ~/.xtrm/ tree entry; delete if identical; on divergence keep-as-override in <repo>/.xtrm/skills/user/packs/local-legacy/<skill>/ (skills) or skip with warning (hooks).
- Remove xtrm-owned settings.json entries (_source == 'xtrm-global' OR canonical hash match) only after confirming ~/.claude/settings.json (or ~/.pi/agent/settings.json) has the equivalent global-scope entry.
- Tarball backup at ~/.xtrm/migration-backups/<repo>-<sha>-{skills,hooks}.tgz before every destructive step.
- Idempotent: second run says 'already migrated'.

## SCOPE
- cli/src/commands/migrate.ts (NEW): 3 subcommands (skills/hooks/all), each: (a) sha-verify identity, (b) tarball backup, (c) delete, (d) log to ~/.xtrm/logs/skills-migration.jsonl.
- cli/src/utils/known-repos.ts (NEW): read/write ~/.xtrm/known-repos.json.
- cli/src/index.ts: register migrate command.
- Tests: cli/src/tests/migrate.test.ts (integration).

## NON_GOALS
- xt migrate --restore <backup> (defer to xtrm-bq7yd.5.2 / follow-up)
- Migration SKILL.md documenting workflow (defer to follow-up)
- --all-repos glob support (defer to follow-up)

## CONSTRAINTS
- Reuse: cli/src/core/drift.ts SHA-256 engine; cli/src/core/global-skills-flag.ts + global-hooks-flag.ts; cli/src/core/skills-layout.ts::resolveGlobalSkillsRoot.
- Dry-run is DEFAULT; require --apply for destructive.
- Every destructive action logs backup path + files removed.
- GitNexus impact pre-authorized: NEW code, no symbol modifications.

## VALIDATION
- cd cli && npm run typecheck && npm run build
- cd cli && npx vitest run src/tests/migrate.test.ts
- xt migrate --dry-run --repo <tmpdir> prints planned action without touching filesystem.

## OUTPUT
Files touched, symbols added, test pass/fail.
